description: This file defines a REST API for managing charts in the Superset application, including CRUD operations, caching, exporting, importing, and favorite management.

classes.name: ChartRestApi
classes.description: REST API class for managing chart resources, including CRUD, caching, exporting, importing, and favorite operations.

methods.name: ensure_thumbnails_enabled
methods.description: Checks if thumbnail feature is enabled before processing thumbnail-related requests.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a chart by id or uuid.

methods.name: cache_screenshot
methods.description: Computes and caches a screenshot of a chart.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.description: Retrieves a cached screenshot of a chart.

methods.name: thumbnail
methods.description: Computes or retrieves a cached thumbnail of a chart.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports multiple charts as a ZIP file.

methods.name: favorite_status
methods.description: Checks which charts are favorited by the current user.

methods.name: add_favorite
methods.description: Marks a chart as favorite for the current user.

methods.name: remove_favorite
methods.description: Removes a chart from the current user's favorites.

methods.name: warm_up_cache
methods.description: Warms up the cache for a chart.

methods.name: import_
methods.description: Imports charts from a ZIP file.
